newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian sues Michael Jackson over accident - TV.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian sues Michael Jackson over accident - TV.

text.p: A Brazilian student is suing popstar Michael Jackson for $9.5 million over a car accident that happened four years ago, a television news broadcast said on Monday.
Globo news said Marcio de Palma, who was run over by a car in 1993, claims that Jackson, who was on a concert tour in Brazil at the time, was travelling in the car.
Jackson denies he was in the car, saying he only went to visit Palma in a hospital because the family had asked him to, Globo news said.
Palma, who had three operations on his leg as a result of the accident, claims Jackson made him many promises to pay damages and help him and his sister with their studies, but no money ever arrived.
